input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Section 19.1 gives an untimed professional/workmanlike Services warranty and a conformance-to-documentation warranty, 19.3 covers malicious code and Applicable Law, and 19.4 supplies repair/replacement and refund remedies. However, Section 19.2 limits conformity to fifteen days after delivery and expressly ends Vendor's correction and refund obligations thereafter, which falls below the fallback floor of 90 days for software conformance and undercuts the 19.4 remedies. We therefore extend the period to ninety days, apply it to software as well as Deliverables, and delete the cut-off, landing the clause at the fallback level; the remaining preferred items (12-month software period) are noted but not pressed.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
mappings.quote: Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards, this Agreement, and each Order Form.

mappings.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
mappings.quote: Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge.
Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.

proposal.summary: Extend conformity warranty to ninety days, cover software, and delete the fifteen-day cut-off of correction and refund obligations
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extend the conformity warranty from fifteen to ninety days and apply it to software as well as Deliverables, and we delete the words cutting off Vendor's correction and refund obligations after that date so the Section 19.4 repair/replace and refund remedies remain available. This meets our fallback position (90 days for software, 30 days for services).

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety days after delivery or first availability, each Deliverable and any software will materially conform to its documentation.
